claims.text: The NCEL model verifies generalization ability by evaluating its performance on five publicly available datasets.
NCEL is trained using Wikipedia hyperlinks to avoid overfitting and is tested on various benchmarks to assess generalization.
The model consistently outperforms various baselines, indicating its favorable generalization ability.
